steps.content: She keeps walking down the slowly collapsing street. The pedestrians are dispersing and fleeing, but they're all phantoms without physical bodies.
But the bullets are real, the flames are real, and the intensifying violence is real.
She walks past the rusty factories. A Molotov cocktail flies her way, and the igniting flame burns her skin.

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Open the door, I need work! I'll go to the mines, I'm not scared of the contamination, and I'll mine Hypercubes for you! You can't go bankrupt, otherwise... what are we supposed to do?

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Give me back my job! Give it back! Don't move to Eastside, don't leave us behind...!!
She doesn't stay but keeps going. She walks to the shabby welfare center and as she reaches out to open the door, an iron hammer wrecks the wall and bricks fall on her body.

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: They're closed! Starting today, there will be no more welfare centers!! The great explosion has lead to tens of thousands of orphans, and they can't afford to care for all of them. They'll abandon us sooner or later!

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Bah! Those old hypocrites. I'm killing them all before they sell me somewhere!! Hahahaha, hahahaha!!
Zoya gets up from the ground. Without a home to go back to, she turns and keeps walking, toward the burning street block.
A stray bullet hits the scrawny body, making her stumble. Indistinct and chaotic voices can be heard in the direction the bullet came from.

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Hand over the money! You haven't eaten in one f***ing day. Well, I haven't eaten in three days!

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Haha...ha... I-I didn't do it on purpose, it was you who... I was only defending myself... No, the gun went off by accident. I didn't kill anyone...

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: We must find a way to make money... I have some connections. How about we smuggle some guns? In fact... we can even traffic people... and drugs... We can do it together...

steps.speaker: Phantom Crowd
steps.content: Hahahaha! I belong to a gang now and I have a gun! You all must listen to me!! Got a problem with that? How does the bullet taste? You still have a problem now? Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Indistinct Figures
steps.content: This is our territory! Give me back my buddies! We can only control people with power... We need more weapons... Everyone's doing this anyway... I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you!!
You can't stop these things from harming her, and you can't count how many times she's gotten hurt. She keeps walking forward without stopping, but ahead of her, there's nowhere she can be.

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: ...Is it still not over...

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: <size=30>Still not... over...?</size>
Amid the blasts of bullets and bombs, wails and laughter, Zoya's figure is slowly falling apart.
The phantoms have finally given up their disguises. They've transformed into ferocious thugs and are pointing their guns at Zoya...
